title: Pyrolysis Plant Hearing & Key Appointments
summary:
*   **Waste-to-Energy Discussion:** Officials discussed the "Waste to Energy Project" as part of a City Manager's report.
*   **Pyrolysis Plant Public Hearing:** A public hearing was scheduled for November 5, 1987, to gather input on the proposed Pyrolysis Plant, a specific waste-to-energy initiative.
*   **Key Appointments Made:** New members were appointed to the Travis County Appraisal District Board of Directors and the Comprehensive Plan Steering Committee.
*   **No New Ordinances:** No action was taken on any new ordinances during this special called meeting.

BOARD & COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS
